newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj investors present guarantees.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj investors present guarantees.

text.p: Brazilian banks Banco Itau and Bradesco have presented the financial guarantees qualifying them to participate in the privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro's state bank Banco do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Banerj), a state planning department official said.

She said the auction, which was originally scheduled to take place on December 17, would go ahead as planned on December 26. The auction was rescheduled after the state succeeded in lifting a court injunction that blocked the sell-off last Tuesday. The injunction had been granted to the Association of Banerj's employees, an opponent of the privatization.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
